entities.summary: Colonial Conquest and Resistance, a transformative movement in Kazakhstan (1847–1870). Emerged from Kenesary Khan leads the last major Kazakh uprising against Russian rule. Catalyzed Central Asian Revolt and Settler Colonialism and 1916 Revolt.
